keyboard.action: Focusing the trigger shows the tooltip anchored to it; leaving it hides the tooltip. In a pinned tooltip, Tab moves through its close button and content in ordinary order, without a trap.
Hides the tooltip without moving focus; a pinned tooltip closes and focus returns to the trigger. The trigger's own Escape behaviour is not triggered.

On a trigger whose tooltip overflows, the first Enter or Space pins it as a popover and moves focus into it, in place of the trigger's own action. Otherwise act on the trigger as usual; the tooltip hides on activation.

responsive: The popup sits 12px right of and below the pointer and follows it; it flips to the side with room, keeps an 8px gutter and is never clipped by the viewport. It is at most 24rem wide and 40vh tall, wraps, and scrolls beyond that; at 320px it is as wide as the viewport minus the gutter. Without a pointer it anchors below the trigger, or above. RTL mirrors the placement (left of the pointer) and keeps the shortcut at the end.

portability.web: the trigger carries aria-describedby to a <div role=tooltip>; visibility toggles the hidden attribute after a 300 ms open delay and hides as soon as the pointer leaves the trigger; positioned fixed at z.popover by the shared hover-helper algorithm (@j3w1/ui/enhance/hover-helper, D-042): 12px right of and below the pointer, following it each animation frame, flipping at the viewport edges inside an 8px gutter, anchored to the trigger for keyboard focus and touch; capped at 40vh with overflow auto, the wheel over the trigger scrolling it while it can scroll; a click, tap or Enter on a trigger whose tooltip overflows pins it as a non-modal popover (role dialog, a close button, focus inside, Escape returns focus); the tooltip is never the only place a control's name lives.
nativeFallbacks: GTK4 tooltip-text; the host draws it with the overlay border through the tooltip css node.
Qt QToolTip stylesheet; border and background from the tokens; no rounded corners.
Terminal UI: the description in the status line while the control is focused.

nonExamples:
A rounded bubble with an arrow. A shadow, or a fade longer than 150 ms. The
tooltip as an icon button's only accessible name. A link or button inside
(that is a popover). Opening on focus but not hover, or on hover with no delay.
A `title` attribute. A pointer-opened tooltip pinned to its trigger instead of
following the pointer, or one that eases after it. A close delay. A long
tooltip cut off, or one that closes before it can be scrolled. Moving focus on
hover.
